# Peau de peur — proposition visuelle v1

Illustration de fiction produite avec l’outil intégré image_gen. Le corps sous la marche est matériel ; la silhouette sur le palier est une apparence. Leur visibilité simultanée sert la lecture de l’image.

[Image](peau-de-peur-v1.png)

## Prompt

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a cinematic photoreal painterly fantasy bestiary illustration of a PEAU DE PEUR, an original instinctive non-living creature of illusion. Scene: dim medieval wooden staircase leading into a grain loft, sacks in the upper background, warm lantern light from below and cold moonlight through a narrow slit. Critical composition shows BOTH the real creature and the false silhouette it produces, clearly spatially separate. Camera low side three-quarter near the top steps. Main real creature occupies a shadowed recess beside and beneath the uppermost stair, visible to the viewer: a flattened coherent animal made of overlapping soft leathery membranes, small glandular pouches, fine gripping extremities and folded skin layers; muted brown, charcoal, waxy translucent edges, no human skin appearance, no gore. One folded membrane rubs against another, leaving a thin oily iridescent film on nearby wood, suggesting secretion and mixing. On the open landing just above and forward of the hidden creature appears a vague crouching threatening silhouette, ambiguous between a hunched person and an animal, edges slightly inconsistent, semi-transparent in places, no detailed face. This is a sensory apparition, NOT a solid second creature, not a ghost of a dead person. An ordinary long wooden pole extends from off-frame below, passing visibly through the false silhouette without bending or impact, its far tip approaching the folded real body near the stair. No visible person needed. Keep real creature anatomy large and readable, illusion secondary but unmistakable; use visual contrast between tactile sharp membrane body and unstable soft silhouette. The creature is instinctive and morally neutral, no villain grin. Restrained original medieval fantasy, beautiful unsettling material detail, strong spatial storytelling, no holographic projector, no magical beam linking creature and apparition, no floating runes, no text, no watermark. Landscape image, proposed visual anatomy.
